automatable_note: OPTO models have no BEC; the manual does not say how the signal side is powered.

entry.confirm_signal: Two beeps (English page); Chinese page: wait 3 s, beep-beep
steps: Wait: two beeps = programming mode (Chinese page: wait 3 s first; its example waits for four 'beep-beep' groups)

announce.description: Two item tones loop: 1 short beep is item 1 (mode), 2 short beeps is item 2 (motor timing). Value tones: 1-4 short beeps, 1 long beep (value 5), 1 long + 1 short (value 6).

select.description: Item: throttle to 0 % when the wanted item tone sounds. The motor then keeps beeping the value tones.

value_select.description: Value: throttle to 100 % on the wanted value tone; a special tone confirms the save (Chinese page).

scheme.confirm_signal: Special tone after a value is stored (stated on the Chinese page only).
scheme.exit: Disconnect the battery to save and quit; or keep listening to continue.
scheme.description: Throttle at 100 %, battery on, beeps mark programming mode. Two item tones loop (1 or 2 short beeps); throttle to 0 % on one enters it; value tones loop; throttle to 100 % on one stores it. Disconnect to leave.

unknowns: Entry wait differs between the English text (two beeps) and the Chinese page (wait 3 s, four beep-beep groups in the example); the entry time in ms is not resolved.
Beep duration, gap and loop length are not stated.
Windows for the throttle gestures are not stated.
Whether item selection returns after a stored value is stated in the Chinese text only (continue waiting returns to the items).
Mode 1 and Mode 2 are described as being for different KV motors; no further meaning is given.
notes: Defaults are the grey cells in the English sound table: Mode 1, timing Auto.
The English page says 1 short beep is the mode menu and two short beeps the motor timing menu; the sound table lists value tones the same way.
